name: Checklist
what: A list that builds one line at a time: a check draws itself (or a box is ticked, a number, a dot), the words slide in beside it, the list re-centres as it grows; earlier lines can fade back.

learned_from.what: the lines with a check, one after another on black
an icon + a word sliding in, later items dimmed

motion: a line every 24 f: the block re-centres 12 f (S-curve), the mark back.out 9 f, the check draws 10 f, the words 12 f
